_renderer_latency.method: 17 renders of one nylon G3 note (program 24, 100 BPM): note-on at tick 0, then at ticks 960, 962, ... 990; lateness = first output sample above 1e-6 minus note-on time x 44100. The tick-0 render gives the sample's own attack delay; the spread of the others shows the 64-sample block on which FluidSynth starts notes
